analysis.reason: 최근 3거래일 연속 하락세 지속, RSI 25.1로 과매도 구간 진입. ADX 17.4로 추세 미형성 상태에서 -DI가 +DI 대비 우위(-DI 49.6 vs +DI 15.7)를 보이며 하락 압력 우세. 5일 평균 대비 거래량 1.73배로 급증하며 하락세에 힘 실림. 52주 저가 대비 32.8% 위치.
analysis.reasonEn: The downtrend has persisted for the last 3 trading days, with RSI entering oversold territory at 25.1. ADX is at 17.4, indicating no trend formation, and the -DI (49.6) is significantly higher than the +DI (15.7), showing downward pressure. Volume surged 1.73x the 5-day average, supporting the decline. Current price is 32.8% from the 52-week low.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($1,262,000) vs SMA5 ($1,482,000)/SMA20 ($1,710,350)/SMA50 ($1,671,148): Below short/mid-term trends, diagnosing a weak zone.
· SMA100 ($1,919,760)/SMA200 ($1,452,545) position: Below long-term trends, weakening further.
· 52-week position (32.8%) + current price near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (46.6→25.1): Entering oversold, strengthening downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-6856.1846→-57833.1178): Bearish expansion, further decline after dead cross.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $1,392,079): Approaching lower band, potential for further decline.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($1,246,000): Close to 5-day/20-day lows, expected to act as key support.
· Swing resistance ($1,890,000): High level relative to current price, expected resistance on short-term bounces.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (5-day low $1,250,000 vs 20-day low $1,250,000): Sideways pattern, uncertainty of trend reversal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.73x 5-day average): Surge, increasing confidence in the downtrend.
· Current zone diagnosis (Accumulation zone): Maintaining a wait-and-see approach due to oversold entry and continued lack of trend.
